source.quote:
Returns an effect that suspends the current fiber for the specified duration
 * without blocking a JavaScript thread.

notes: Use Effect.sleep(duration) for a caller-chosen delay. It sleeps on the fiber clock, so TestClock can advance it; it does not use the live browser clock used by browser waits and operation deadlines. It is interruptible and does not wait for browser readiness.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.
